scope: all ETH actual15000/4500 definitions, complete rules/parameters preserved before freeze

gating.signal: At UTC00:01 use prior completed close fast ROC L3 and strict entry hurdle H0.025. ROC>H proposes short,ROC<-H proposes long. Otherwise retain an actual long iff ROC<E,actual short iff ROC>-E,else flat,where E-0.01 with abs(E)<H. At exact E long exits;at exact -E short exits. E<0 is an early fast ROC exit threshold inside the entry band,before ROC reaches zero;not a PnL stop from entry price. Cash has no hidden desired state and enters only on a fresh strict fast extreme. If actual nonzero position and proposed direction match,retain actual quantity irrespective of slow gate. For cash/reversal entries require at least two exact ROC(S-1,S,S+1) signs match new direction, S28,zero slow magnitude hurdle,ties neutral. Opposite fast extreme has priority;close old position before any permitted opposite entry.
gating.execution: Next UTC00:01 actual OPEN;close before open;fixed N3000/10000bank,quantity=floor(N/prior completed close/lot)*lot. No future OPEN,funding,partial close,NAV sizing or same-direction resizing.
gating.ledger: Opening debitsfeeonly;unrealizedPnL=q*(price-entryexecution). Closing realizes signedq*(exitexecution-entryexecution) and paysfee. Notional is not debited as spot cash.
gating.funding: At actual settlementns,rawcashdelta=-signedq*actualmark*realizedrate. Only oldposition thenheld participates;funding events00:00/00:00.001 occur before00:01rotation. Negative delta multiplied by coststress;positive income not increased. Sourceavailable_ts (often+1hour) retained;rates are ex-post accounting only,never signal or size inputs.
gating.risk: Composite sampled NAV includes minute transaction-close proxies plus actual closed-hour mark and actualfundingsettlement marks,pre/posttrade samples and terminalcash. Report mark-only and trade-proxy DD separately. Marginproxy:1%ofnotional versus adverse full-hour markhigh/low for every overlapping state in completelyin-OOSclosedhours. No exact historicaltier/tick liquidation engine;anyproxybreachfails qualification.
gating.funding_entry_condition: At daily priorclose signal timestamp00:00,select lastN3/6/9realizedsettlements sorted(settlement_ts,source_index) with BOTH available_ts<=signal_ts andsettlement_ts<=signal_ts. RequireNrecords andnewestavailable age<=16h. Exactrational arithmeticmean of recordedrates;for new/reversal proposed direction d(+1long,-1short),permit iff d*meanrate<=C(0/0.00005/0.0001 perrecordedsettlement),equalityallowed. Existingfast-compatibleposition retains actualquantity irrespectiveof fundingcondition. Baseflatcloses;blockedreversalclosesoldpositionandstayscash. Neverusescurrent00settlementifavailable01,futurefunding/predictedrates/mark/multiplier tochoose signal. Actualrealizedfundingcashflows stillchargednormally;this laggedcostproxyisnotforecastor guaranteedfuturecost.
